metadata.title: Pop Portrait with Geometric Color Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait of a young woman featuring messy blonde hair with vibrant multi-colored streaks, framed by vertical geometric color bars and a horizontal lower-third text block.
triggerTerms: pop artist portrait with color bars
messy blonde hair with rainbow highlights
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a young woman with voluminous, wind-swept blonde hair containing hidden streaks of blue, pink, and yellow. The composition is stabilized by three thin vertical color bars on the left and a semi-transparent horizontal gradient bar at the bottom containing sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed slightly off-camera to create a candid feel
Vertical color bars on the left mirroring the verticality of the hair strands
Horizontal text block grounding the airy, messy texture of the upper image
Color streaks in hair echoing the palette of the graphic overlays
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused key lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, filling approximately 70% of the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold lower-third text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the hair downward to the hand, and rest on the horizontal text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform light grey space surrounding the head to allow hair flyaways to be visible.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm blonde and neutral grey background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal, magenta, and yellow vertical bars
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow hair highlights and gold jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements against a desaturated, soft-toned photographic base.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the primary name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a simplified open loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold lowercase primary name paired with all-caps light-weight secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure and high x-height.
Provides the same circular 'o' and 'g' shapes in lowercase.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a young woman with messy blonde hair containing blue and pink highlights, wearing a gold ring, against a grey background. Include three thin vertical lines (teal, magenta, yellow) on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a semi-transparent magenta-to-orange horizontal gradient bar across the bottom third. Place bold white geometric sans-serif text in lowercase on the left side of the bar.

verificationChecks: Vertical color bars are present on the left edge
Background is a neutral, flat grey

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the horizontal text overlay
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Is the text anchored to the lower third?
Are the vertical bars aligned to the left edge?
Does the hair look naturally messy rather than matted?
Is the color palette consistent between the graphics and the hair?
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Messy Textured Hair + Left-aligned Vertical Color Bars + Lower-Third Gradient Text Block
